title: CPSC, BSH Home Appliances Corp. Announce Recall to Repair Range Hoods
summary: These range hoods could have the blower motor installed with a screw that might penetrate the motor housing, posing an electric shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 43.

title: CPSC, Jumpking Inc. Announce Recall of Chrome Dumbbells
summary: Because they do not fit together properly, the weights can fall off the handles of these dumbbells and strike the user. Units: About 1.2 million.

title: CPSC, Marshall Field's Announce Recall of Fire Pit Spark Screen
summary: The fire pit spark screen can catch fire when it comes into direct contact with a flame, posing a burn and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 430.

title: CPSC, Jo-Ann Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Bamboo Torches
summary: The plastic oil canister can melt when the torch is in use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 36,000.

title: CPSC, Target Announce Recall of Summerville™ Toy Truck Sets
summary: Components on the trucks could detach, posing a choking and sharp point hazard to young children. Units: 25,500.

title: CPSC, Tristar Products Inc. Announce Recall of Electric Pressure Washers
summary: These electric pressure washers do not have a ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) on the power cord, which poses a serious electrocution hazard if the unit comes into contact with water. Units: 1,000.

title: CPSC, Georgia Boot Announce Recall of Steel Toe Boots
summary: The boots may have been mislabeled to indicate that they are resistant to electrical current, which is incorrect. This may result in a serious shock or electrocution to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

title: CPSC, NETGEAR Inc. Announce Recall of Wall Plug Ethernet Bridges
summary: The plastic housing on these units can detach, posing a shock hazard. Units: About 53,500.

title: CPSC, Elkay Manufacturing Co. Announce Recall of Bottled Water Coolers
summary: These electric water coolers can overheat and present a fire hazard. Units: 145,000.

title: CPSC, Playworld Systems Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Swing Sets
summary: The weld between the side arch support and the top rail can fail. If that happens, the swings can collapse, causing children on the swings to fall and be injured by the falling top rail. Units: About 1,500.

title: CPSC, Matsushita Electric Corporation of America Announce Recall of Combination TV/VCRs
summary: The TV/VCR cabinets can break when lifted by the ventilation holes in the top rear of the cabinet, permitting the TV/VCR to fall and injure hands and feet. Units: About 500,000.

title: CPSC, Geartec/Mackarl Announce Recall of Bicycle Helmets
summary: The helmets may not meet CPSC safety regulations for helmets, which poses a risk of a rider sustaining a serious head injury if he/she falls from a bicycle. Units: 4,600.

title: CPSC, The W.E. Bassett Company Announce Recall Eyelash Curlers
summary: The plastic handles can detach and cause consumers to lose their grip, resulting in injuries to the eyes and face. Units: 220,000.

title: CPSC, Friedrich Air Conditioning Co. Announce Recall to Repair Packaged Terminal Air Conditioners
summary: The rotary dial switch on these units can be positioned between the high and low speed fan setting. This can cause the units to overheat and possibly catch fire. Units: About 26,400 PTAC units, and about 1,600 replacement heater assemblies used in repairs.
